title: Teller's name on a Project Sign/Grudge UFO review document

tellings.quote: there's a project sign or grudge document >> from pre-blue book >> in the late 40s and Edward Teller's name is on it where he's engaging in a real UFO review.

plain: The physicist Edward Teller, one of the fathers of the hydrogen bomb, took part in a serious review of UFO reports in the late 1940s, according to Michels. He says Teller's name is on a document from Project Sign or Project Grudge, the US Air Force's UFO studies before Blue Book, its better-known UFO study of the 1950s and 60s. Michels tells it himself without showing the document, and it would mean that top weapons scientists were treating UFOs as a real question from the start.
